title.en: Hash a recipe and compare it with the hash field the file carries

goal.en: A published recipe carries its own content hash. Compute the hash of the koshari file, fetch the hub's copy and read the field inside it, and hash that copy too: all three agree.

note.en: Hash the koshari file from the repository.
Fetch the hub's copy; its hash field carries the same value.
Hash the fetched copy. The hash and signature fields are excluded from the computation, so a document can carry its own hash.

outcome.en: You can check that a recipe file is the revision it says it is. Next: scenario 047 shows the hub refusing a request whose hash does not match.
